Create an item from text `content`. Without `list_id` it is added to clipboard history, where it shows up in search. With `list_id` (a private, non-shared pinboard) it is pinned to that pinboard: if the same content is already in history the existing item is pinned (and stays in history), otherwise a new pinned-only item is created that is not added to history. semantics_confirmed_by_strings.create_item: No clipboard write; history by default; list_id pins existing history content or creates pinned-only item without timestamp; type text/color/link auto-detected.
semantics_confirmed_by_strings.delete_item: confirm false/omitted preview; true irreversibly deletes underlying record and pinning.
semantics_confirmed_by_strings.delete_pinboard: confirm false/omitted preview; true deletes board, preserves historical items.
semantics_confirmed_by_strings.search: history and pinboards; default20 max100; text filters/title/app/device; ISO8601 half-open bounds, date-only upper includes full day.
semantics_confirmed_by_strings.read_item: verbatim text/link/color, newline file paths; image payload for image items.
semantics_confirmed_by_strings.update_item: title or content required; empty title clears; image/file body immutable; content reclassifies text/color/link.

explicit_replica_extensions: replica_copy_item (named private pasteboard default; general requires explicit flag)
not_claimed_identical: Original dynamically emitted full tools/list JSON Schema was not queried from the private running application. UUID constraints and exact descriptions/errors are reconstructed choices.
Preview truncation and image resize policy remain implementation limits; exact original thresholds not proven.
Local data persistence architecture and device identity have no cloud sync; no semantic-equivalence or complete 1:1 claim.
